page_title: CAD 0-0 RAY | Cadiz CF v Rayo Vallecano 27/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is sent off! He receives a red card and the match ends for him. He attempts to argue, but the referee's decision is final.
88' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
88' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) serves up a nice cross, but Conan Ledesma punches the ball away.
85' Francisco has decided to substitute Alvaro Garcia and he is replaced by Bebe (Rayo Vallecano).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gonzalo Escalante leaves the pitch and Jose Mari (Cadiz) comes on.
82' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) gets booked.
82' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano).
81' Rayo Vallecano force their opponents to concede a corner.

80' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Conan Ledesma makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.
77' A substitution has been made. Maximiliano Gomez is replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
75' Francisco prepares a substitution. Oscar Trejo is replaced by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
75' The substitution is prepared. Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sergio Camello.
73' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
71' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
68' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
67' The attendance for today's match is 18505.
66' A substitution has been made. Jorge de Frutos goes off and Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
64' Here's the change. Ivan Alejo leaves the pitch and Robert Navarro (Cadiz) comes on as a substitute.
64' Sergio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) replacing Darwin Machis.
64' That's the end of the game for Roger Marti, who is replaced by Chris Ramos (Cadiz).
62' The ball goes out of play. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
60' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luis Hernandez (Cadiz) was quite harsh and Francisco Maeso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' Luis Hernandez (Cadiz) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
58' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles over the bar. Poor effort.
56' Roger Marti (Cadiz) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Stole Dimitrievski is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
55' One of the players from Rayo Vallecano times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
51' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
51' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.

49' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Conan Ledesma pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
45+256' Having seen unsporting behavior, Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Francisco (Rayo Vallecano) is the recipient.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+8' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
45+4' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
43' Although Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is just on the bench, Francisco Maeso has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
43' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
41' A cross into the box from Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) is cleared.
40' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
39' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Rayo Vallecano was in an offside position.
35' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
34' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but Conan Ledesma comes off his line to gather the ball.
32' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
29' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle. Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after dangerous play.
27' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
25' Cadiz CF are seeing far more of the ball now.
23' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is able to continue to play.
21' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
18' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
18' The referee blows his whistle, Cadiz CF are awarded a corner kick.
17' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
13' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.

12' He should have scored! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Conan Ledesma makes an easy save.
9' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
8' A spell of possession for Cadiz CF in an attempt to control the game.
5' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
5' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
3' Rayo Vallecano keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Cadiz CF will take the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso will officiate today.
